messages:
Marta R: FYI I just got the asset bundle from the partner (Hestia-13B). s3://acq.redwood/hestia/hestia-13b_v1.tar.gz. They provided md5 and a detached sig.
Evan T: copying link. can you paste the manifest hash? we need to gate before registry push.
Marta R: manifest md5=5f2b9c1d, sig=partner_hestia_v1.sig, key-id=partner-kp-01. uploader says tokenizer v2 (sentencepiece) included.
acq-bot: Upload event recorded: hestia-13b_v1.tar.gz uploaded by partner-ci (ip 35.201.x.x). Scan queued.
Lin (oncall): I'll run the first provenance checklist. Steps: verify signature, verify manifest vs s3 object, sanity-run tokenizer sample, check tokenizer vocab sha.
Priya S: tagging @Evan T for provenance and @Noah for quant bench scheduling. Also need to decide priority: is this critical path for any customer P0?
Noah: Not flagged as P0 by sales. Recommend medium priority. We can slot bring-up in the next non-blocking sprint but should run smoke eval asap to rule out obvious regressions.
Evan T: Prov checklist (short):
1) `gpg --verify partner_hestia_v1.sig manifest.json`
2) `aws s3api head-object --bucket acq.redwood --key hestia/hestia-13b_v1.tar.gz --version-id <ver>`
3) compute md5/sha256 locally and compare to manifest
4) `s3://acq.redwood/hestia/manifest.json` (verify tokenizer.vocab_sha)
I'll do (1-3) now.
Marta R: also note the tarball contains a weights/ dir (checkpoint_0000.bin), tokenizer/spm.model, license.txt, and a README with partner provenance notes.
Evan T: gpg verification passed. manifest sha256 matches. starting fast tokenizer sanity: sample 100 toks across test prompts.
Lin (oncall): Good. If tokenizer vocab sha mismatches we stop and open a custody ticket. Also add KMS wrapping check: partner says keys in partner-kp-01, need to confirm fingerprint.
Priya S: For quant experiments, suggested path: baseline fp16 run on a small A100 pod, then q4_0 q4_k on same test harness. If quality delta < 1.5% on rouge/accuracy we proceed to staged quant rollouts.
Noah: I'll book a 2hr slot on Wed 09:00-11:00 for fp16 + q4 smoke. Will need a snapshot of eval prompts: `evalsets/bringup/hestia-smoke-50.jsonl` (small set) and `bench/latency/shortseq`.
Marta R: who will push to registry after prov checks? we should also attach provenance metadata (uploader, sig, manifest with checksum, software used to create weights).
Evan T: I'll own registry push IF prov checks pass. Registry fields to populate: model_id=hestia-13b, version=2024-06-20-partner_v1, provenance={uploader, sig_key, md5, sha256, k8s-commit}
Noah: For the smoke eval, metric thresholds: token-level perplexity not to degrade > 5% vs our reference; safety filters pass for 100% of samples; latency <= 1.1x reference on p99.
Lin (oncall): small snag — tokenizer vocab sha didn't match manifest. vocab sha in manifest=3a7d... but file's vocab sha=3a7f... likely packaging issue.
Marta R: that's bad. partner slack pinged earlier about a repack, maybe they re-generated tokenizer. Evan, can you open custody ticket and request corrected artifact? include original sig and manifest in ticket.
Evan T: opened ticket #ACQ-4528: "Hestia tokenizer sha mismatch". Pinged partner with request for corrected tarball and signed manifest. Included hash diffs. Partner acknowledged and will re-upload within 24h.
acq-bot: Ticket created ACQ-4528 by Evan T. Linking upload scan results and original s3 object.
Priya S: ok hold quant schedule until corrected bundle lands. Meanwhile we can prepare eval harness and e2e checklist: runtime config, batch sizes, kv cache settings, tokenization roundtrip tests.
Noah: I'll create CI job `bringup/hestia/quick-smoke` with these commands:
```bash
# download
aws s3 cp s3://acq.redwood/hestia/hestia-13b_v1.tar.gz ./
# extract
tar -xzf hestia-13b_v1.tar.gz
# run smoke
go run ./bench/quick -model ./weights -prompts evalsets/bringup/hestia-smoke-50.jsonl
```
Noah: job created but gated pending ACQ-4528 resolution.
Marta R: thanks all. Action items: Evan = prov + ticket owner; Noah = bench job + slot; Lin = oncall verification; Priya = quant plan + thresholds; I'll coordinate partner comms. Ping here when corrected bundle is uploaded.
Lin (oncall): noted. I'll add a small note to the registry template to record 'packaging_attempts' field so we can trace if partner re-uploads.
Evan T: partner just replied — they think the tokenizer v2 was accidentally swapped. they'll re-sign and re-upload tonight.
Marta R: great. closing for now but keep thread for re-upload confirmation. :wave:
